recipe.visualDefinition: A medium portrait of a man in a light-colored suit jacket against a surreal nocturnal desert landscape. A piano keyboard extends into the distance on the right, merging with the horizon under a dark blue twilight sky featuring a small, bright moon.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in the left foreground balanced by the receding piano on the right
Cool blue color palette contrasted by the warm skin tones of the face
Sharp foreground focus transitioning into a soft, hazy desert background
Verticality of the figure against the strong diagonal of the piano keys
coreInvariants: Receding perspective of the piano keys
Small, circular moon in the upper right quadrant
Direct eye contact from the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up, appearing large and dominant in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, moves down the light suit, follows the diagonal line of the piano keys into the distance, and ends at the moon in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark blue sky and distant mountains provide a vast, quiet negative space that emphasizes the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cobalt and navy blue define the environment and mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale lavender-blue of the suit jacket provides a mid-tone contrast against the dark background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm peach and tan skin tones provide the only warm break in the cool palette.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright suit and dark sky; low saturation in the background to create depth.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool blues and neutral skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with high contrast between thicks and thins
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, italicized version of the same serif family for secondary text.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule separating text from the top edge

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the delicate 80s editorial serif look
Classic transitional serif with high contrast

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with curly hair in a light blue suit, standing in a dark blue desert at night. A piano keyboard should stretch from the right foreground into the distant horizon. A small moon is in the dark blue sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply white serif text in the top right corner, using a light weight font with tight tracking. Ensure the text is small enough to feel like a subtle label.

verificationChecks: Does the piano recede into the distance?
Is the text a high-contrast serif?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person

mustAchieve: Clean, professional studio lighting on the face
Precise perspective on the piano keys

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct perspective on the piano keys
Ensure the blue color cast doesn't wash out skin tones completely
Verify the moon is a simple circle without complex craters
Confirm the text is legible but not overwhelming
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + [Light Suit] + [Nocturnal Desert] + [Receding Piano] + [Blue Color Grade] + [Serif Typography Top-Right]
